companyContext: Inter IKEA Systems B.V. is the worldwide IKEA franchisor and owner of the IKEA Concept, supplying affordable, well-designed Scandinavian home furnishings and accessories through more than 460 stores and ikea.com in 60+ markets.
brandContext: IKEA is the Swedish-origin home furnishings retailer offering ready-to-assemble furniture, kitchen appliances, décor and lifestyle accessories sold under flat-pack democratic-design principles. The French e-commerce site (ikea.com/fr) regularly showcases its 'Nouveautés' assortment.

typography.fontUses: Display headings and hero titles on ikea.com (custom IKEA cut of Noto Sans)
Section headings and product titles (web fallback when Noto IKEA isn't loaded)
Body copy, product descriptions and UI labels
Buttons, navigation links and emphasised inline text
System fallback typeface used in emails and contexts where Noto cannot be served
Logotype lockup only (proprietary, Futura-derived); never used for body or UI

brandVision: To create a better everyday life for the many people by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible will be able to afford them.
brandValues: Togetherness, caring for people and planet, cost-consciousness, simplicity, renew and improve, different with a meaning, give and take responsibility, lead by example — all rooted in Swedish democratic design (form, function, quality, sustainability, low price).
